title: "DASC3240_Final_Project_Scatterplot"
format: html
editor: visual
server: shiny
---

## Running Code

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load data
basketball <- read.csv("/Users/winliao/Desktop/DASC3240_Assignment/basketball.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Clean data
basketball_clean <- basketball %>%
  filter(!is.na(height), !is.na(avg_minutes_played), 
         !is.na(avg_points), !is.na(avg_assists), 
         !is.na(avg_rb), !is.na(field_goal_pct),
         avg_minutes_played > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    points_per_minute = avg_points / avg_minutes_played,
    assists_per_minute = avg_assists / avg_minutes_played,
    rebounds_per_minute = avg_rb / avg_minutes_played,
    player_label = paste0(
      player_name, "<br>",
      "Team: ", team, "<br>",
      "PPG: ", round(avg_points, 2), "<br>",
      "APG: ", round(avg_assists, 2), "<br>",
      "RPG: ", round(avg_rb, 2), "<br>",
      "FG%: ", round(field_goal_pct, 3)
    )
  )

# UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Basketball Player Performance Explorer"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        "metric",
        "Choose Metric:",
        choices = c(
          "Points per Minute" = "points",
          "Assists per Minute" = "assists",
          "Rebounds per Minute" = "rebounds",
          "Field Goal %" = "fg"
        )
      ),

      radioButtons(
        "player_type",
        "Player Type:",
        choices = c("Bench" = "bench", "Starter" = "starter"),
        selected = "bench"
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("mainPlot")
    )
  )
)

# Server
server <- function(input, output) {

  filtered_data <- reactive({
    if (input$player_type == "bench") {
      basketball_clean %>% filter(starter == FALSE)
    } else {
      basketball_clean %>% filter(starter == TRUE)
    }
  })

  output$mainPlot <- renderPlotly({

    data <- filtered_data()

    y_var <- switch(input$metric,
                    "points" = data$points_per_minute,
                    "assists" = data$assists_per_minute,
                    "rebounds" = data$rebounds_per_minute,
                    "fg" = data$field_goal_pct)

    y_label <- switch(input$metric,
                      "points" = "Points Per Minute",
                      "assists" = "Assists Per Minute",
                      "rebounds" = "Rebounds Per Minute",
                      "fg" = "Field Goal %")

    title_text <- paste(
      ifelse(input$player_type == "bench", "Bench Players:", "Starters:"),
      y_label, "vs Playing Time"
    )

    p <- ggplot(data,
                aes(x = avg_minutes_played,
                    y = y_var,
                    color = team,
                    text = player_label)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +  # fixed small dots
      labs(
        title = title_text,
        x = "Minutes Per Game",
        y = y_label,
        color = "Team"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",

        # spacing fixes
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15)),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 20)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01))

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
      layout(
        legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.3),
        margin = list(b = 110)
      )
  })
}

# Run app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
